_comment: Sub-Channel under the Referral channel. Per Yash's spec (2026-09-15),
amended 2026-09-15 to route customer-initiated referrals to Online.
1. referrer_role present and listed in role_map  -> that bucket
2. referrer_role = Customer                      -> CApp if utm_campaign is
3. referrer_role BLANK and source in online_sources -> Online
Rule 3 is the amendment. referrer_role is populated only when an employee
took the referral (it is 100% collinear with referrer_email), so a blank role
on an Existing Cx referral means the customer raised it themselves -- whether
prompted by a campaign or not. 65% of these carry a utm_campaign across 499
distinct campaigns. The campaign/unprompted split is kept in sub_channel_detail.
Matching normalises: lowercase + all whitespace removed, which folds the three
referrer_role, utm_campaign and referrer_email ALL have a TRAILING SPACE in
their real column names -- see sql/02_referrals.sql.
'SC - Referral Calling' does not appear in the data yet; kept for when it does.
